title: Move repo-root hooks/ -> packages/bee/hooks + plugin manifest, catalog, probe, CI, installer refs
action: Per D2 + validation repairs C3/C4/B5/B6/B7/B8. `git mv hooks packages/bee/hooks`, then: (1) onboard_bee.mjs PLUGIN_HOOKS_DIR :91 -> path.join(PLUGIN_ROOT,'packages','bee','hooks'). (2) repoOwnsHookCatalog :2205 — this probe is bee's SELF-identification (read :2196-2204: without it, onboard --apply clobbers bee's own .codex/hooks.json and test_hook_contracts goes red next run): update to packages/bee/hooks/catalog.mjs (keep the legacy hooks/catalog.mjs check as OR-fallback for old checkouts). (3) packages/bee/hooks/catalog.mjs :86 command template `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/${script}"` -> `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packages/bee/hooks/${script}`; then regenerate/update packages/bee/hooks/claude-hooks.json (11 command strings) and packages/bee/hooks/hooks.json (11 command strings) — if catalog.mjs is their generator, regen; else sweep by hand. (4) .claude-plugin/plugin.json:9 "hooks": "./hooks/claude-hooks.json" -> "./packages/bee/hooks/claude-hooks.json"; check .codex-plugin/plugin.json for an equivalent hooks ref. (5) run_verify.mjs DISCOVERY_ROOTS 'hooks' -> 'packages/bee/hooks'. (6) release_manifest.mjs :133 enumerateTree hooks walk -> packages/bee/hooks (role name plugin_hook KEPT — proveInstalledPackage and plugin_distribution :209-211 substring match /hooks/<name> still passes on the new path). (7) okf_instructions_fence.mjs:358 walk(root/'hooks') -> packages/bee/hooks. (8) scripts/tests: test_verify_manifest:62-64 pinned hooks suite paths; test_compact_capsule:92; test_compaction_advisories:68-69; test_doctrine_parity:92,106 (readdir root/hooks + hooks/claude-hooks.json); test_installers_e2e:352 required-roots: DROP 'hooks'. (9) install.ps1:317 sparse-checkout: DROP 'hooks'. (10) windows.yml :35-37 hooks comments/paths, canary.yml:6 comment. (11) Sweep remainder: rg -l '(^|[^a-z])hooks/' scripts/ skills/ .github/ for stragglers referencing repo-root hooks (host-repo .claude/settings.json style refs to .bee/bin/hooks are UNTOUCHED — that is the vendored mirror). REGEN OBLIGATION in this order: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.

truths: repoOwnsHookCatalog fires on this repo post-move (probe self-test: onboard --apply does NOT write a host projection into .codex/hooks.json)
plugin.json hooks ref resolves to an existing file
every command string in claude-hooks.json/hooks.json points at packages/bee/hooks/
release manifest still carries plugin_hook records (new paths)
install.ps1 sparse set has packages, not hooks
artifacts: packages/bee/hooks/ complete (18 entries incl catalog.mjs, claude-hooks.json, hooks.json, 4 test suites)
prohibitions: no HAND-edits under .bee/bin — only onboard_bee.mjs --apply writes there
host-repo probe fallback must not be deleted outright — keep OR-fallback

trace.outcome: git mv hooks -> packages/bee/hooks (history-preserving) + fix-forward every path reference: onboard_bee.mjs PLUGIN_HOOKS_DIR/repoOwnsHookCatalog (legacy OR-fallback kept), catalog.mjs commandFor + regenerated claude-hooks.json/hooks.json, both plugin manifests, run_verify.mjs discovery root, release_manifest.mjs hooks walk, okf_instructions_fence.mjs surface+walk (self-test bug found and fixed), install.ps1 sparse set, CI comments, 10 test suites in the cell's files list plus 8 more found via a broader sweep (test_onboard_bee.mjs, test_conformance.mjs, test_hook_vendor_closure.mjs, test_heartbeat_touch.mjs, test_lib_mirror.mjs, test_bee_write_guard_hook.mjs, test_bee_cli.mjs, packages/bee/bee.mjs's own parallel doctor diagnostics), plus import-depth fixes inside the moved hook test files themselves and 2 pinned assertions in test_hook_contracts.mjs. Regenerated impact-registry, plugin skill trees, release manifest via self-onboard --apply. Full run_verify.mjs green (105 suites) + release_manifest --check clean.
deviations: Auto-fixed (blocking issue in touched code, rule 3): 4 static ESM/relative imports inside packages/bee/hooks/*.mjs test files (test_hook_contracts.mjs, test_model_guard.mjs, test_write_guard.mjs, test_bypass_stop_net.mjs) hardcoded a 1-up '../scripts/lib/run-module-worker.mjs' and test_write_guard.mjs's own '../.bee/bin/lib/lease-store.mjs' relative import, both correct only while hooks/ sat at repo root; after the move to packages/bee/hooks/ these needed 3-up depth. Also fixed each file's own REPO_ROOT = path.dirname(HOOKS_DIR) runtime constant to the correct 3-up climb (path.dirname x3).

Auto-fixed (bug in touched code, rule 1): scripts/okf_instructions_fence.mjs's own isSurface()/listSurfaceFiles() walk still scanned bare 'hooks/' after the SURFACES spec was updated to packages/bee/hooks/** -- would have silently stopped fencing hook output. Updated isSurface's startsWith check and the walk() call together; ran --selftest (23/23 pass) to confirm the fence still bites on the live tree.

Auto-added (missing critical functionality, rule 2): packages/bee/bee.mjs's own 'bee doctor' diagnostics carry a PARALLEL, hand-ported copy of onboard_bee.mjs's repoOwnsHookCatalog/doctorHookHandlersResolvable/doctorHookSourcesCodex/doctorClaudeHandlersResolvable -- none were in the cell's files list. Updated all 5 path.join(root,'hooks',...) call sites to packages/bee/hooks, keeping the legacy hooks/ OR-fallback (same pattern the cell mandated for onboard_bee.mjs's own repoOwnsHookCatalog) so an older bee checkout still self-identifies.

Auto-added (rule 2): skills/bee-hive/scripts/test_onboard_bee.mjs (4 spots), scripts/tests/test_conformance.mjs, test_hook_vendor_closure.mjs, test_heartbeat_touch.mjs, test_lib_mirror.mjs, and packages/bee/tests/{test_bee_write_guard_hook.mjs,test_bee_cli.mjs} all read the real repo's hooks/ tree via REPO_ROOT-relative paths outside the cell's declared files list; without updating them run_verify.mjs goes red. Updated each to packages/bee/hooks/.

Auto-added (rule 2): .codex-plugin/plugin.json had no explicit 'hooks' field, relying on Codex's undocumented plugin-root default lookup at hooks/hooks.json (catalog.mjs's own header comment names this mechanism). Since the file moved, added an explicit "hooks": "./packages/bee/hooks/hooks.json" field mirroring the pattern .claude-plugin/plugin.json already uses explicitly. Updated the paired regression guard in packages/bee/hooks/test_hook_contracts.mjs's codex-default-hooks-route check (previously it only accepted 'undefined' or the stale './hooks/hooks.json' literal as proof of the route -- now requires the explicit new canonical override, since that pre-move literal no longer names an existing file).

Auto-fixed (rule 3): packages/bee/hooks/test_hook_contracts.mjs's own catalog-drift check pinned a literal expected command string 'node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bee-codex-subagent-audit.mjs"' -- updated to the new packages/bee/hooks/ path to match catalog.mjs's regenerated projections.

Investigated but NOT fixed (out of cell scope, pre-existing, proven via git-stash baseline on commit 8bff2a8): standalone `node packages/bee/hooks/test_write_guard.mjs`/test_hook_contracts.mjs invocations show 3 write-guard-hold checks (own-session-hold-never-blocks, legacy-session-less-row-never-blocks, no-session-id-is-zero-difference-even-with-a-hold) failing deterministically -- reproduced identically on the pre-move commit with a clean env, so unrelated to this cell's diff. These do NOT fail through the actual verify path (BEE_VERIFY_CONCURRENCY=12 node scripts/run_verify.mjs), which isolates each suite's execution environment; the full chain is green. Not filed as a fix-first cell since it never surfaces through the recorded commands.verify/commands.test chain -- flagged here for visibility only.
